fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/pocahontas-campground ('Single Site: $8 per night | Camping fee is $8.00 per site per night, payable at the camping self-service fee station', page last updated June 2, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351729/rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-04-20 to 2026-11-12, Single $8 per night), read 2026-10-21

values.note: First-come, first-served; pay at the self-service fee station. Check-out 2 pm. Limit 2 vehicles per campsite.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/pocahontas-campground ('Maximum length of stay is 14 days. Check-out time is 2:00 p.m.'; fee 'payable at the camping self-service fee station') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351729 (rates are a 'First-come, First-served Season', 'Walk In'; notice 'Limit 2 vehicles per campsite'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/pocahontas-campground ('This campground has 8 sites that provide plenty of space for tents or campers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Vault toilet open seasonally; bear-safe trash cans.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/pocahontas-campground ('Vault toilets are available seasonally at this site', 'Potable water is not available at this site', 'bear safe trashcans and a vault toilet'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS, Monongahela NF (Marlinton-White Sulphur RD). Primitive sites for tents or campers just off paved SR 92, with the Two Lick trailhead at the entrance. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated 2026-06-02) and recreation.gov confirm $8/night single site (2026 rate table), first-come only with self-pay, 8 sites, no hookups, vault toilet (seasonal), no potable water; added the 14-day stay limit and 2 pm check-out. Season not stated (the rec.gov FCFS rate season Apr 20-Nov 12 is a rate season, not recorded). No rig length stated ('plenty of space for tents or campers'). No current alert or forest order for SR 92 or the campground. recreation.gov lists a contact (681) 368-0663 and email visit@svlandmgt.com, suggesting a contractor handles it; it is not marked commercially managed. Note trimmed of the site count, toilets/water/hookups and FCFS restatements, and 'small' (the FS page says the sites give 'plenty of space').
